1.consolidated_definition: Lugar donde se entrenan los gallos. Allí se embotan y se chatean durante el traqueo y se realizan otras actividades relacionadas a su crianza y mantenimiento. Existe la variante galleril. En Cuba y algunos lugares de Puerto Rico, gallería. En el breve Diccionario Gallístico de Navas, se describe como ‘casa de gallos o donde se trabajan los gallos’.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Location where roosters are trained. There, they are beak-trimmed and wing-clipped during the training process, as well as other activities related to their care and maintenance. The variant galleril exists. In Cuba and some areas of Puerto Rico, it is also known as a gallería. In the brief Gallistic Dictionary by Navas, it is described as 'rooster house or where roosters are worked'.
